title: Raise a seed round
summary: Data room standing, SAFEs signed, wires verified, cap table made true.

parts.title: Set up a data room
parts.guidance: Organize the seed-round data room around the company's current corporate, financial, ownership and operating evidence. Identify document owners and gaps before inviting investors. Review permissions and authorize each sharing scope, retaining the actual versions disclosed so later diligence and closing questions can be answered from the same record.

parts.title: Raise pre-seed (SAFEs)
parts.guidance: Run the proposed SAFE financing from the agreed fundraising strategy and current company records. Use the fundraising workflow to review instrument terms, approve investor communications, obtain signatures and verify received funds. Keep each investor's closing status explicit, carrying completed instruments and exceptions into ownership records without equating interest or a signature alone with a funded close.

parts.title: Update cap table
parts.guidance: Reconcile the ownership record to the SAFE instruments and other transactions actually completed during the round. Apply approved updates with links to supporting documents, funds evidence and any reviewed calculations. Preserve a dated post-round version and unresolved discrepancies so future financing or employee grants begin from a consistent account of outstanding commitments.
